methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date (2026-06-13); transactional email is billed as a flat monthly plan that bundles an included email volume, so monthlyUsd holds the published plan price and the included volume plus per-1,000-email overage rate are recorded in notes. Quote-only/Enterprise/Premier tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null; HIPAA/BAA and minutes/calls/overage-per-min/per-call fields do not apply to email APIs and are null for every tier. Every figure is sourced to the fetched pricing page.

vendors.name: Amazon SES
vendors.provenance: https://aws.amazon.com/ses/pricing/ (official AWS pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; pure usage-based pricing with no flat monthly plans, so monthlyUsd is null and per-1,000 rates are recorded in notes)

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (Outbound)
plans.notes: Usage-based, no flat fee: $0.10 per 1,000 emails sent, plus $0.12 per GB of attachment data. Free tier of up to 3,000 message charges/month for the first 12 months.

plans.name: Inbound
plans.notes: Usage-based: $0.10 per 1,000 emails received, plus $0.09 per 1,000 incoming email chunks.

plans.name: Dedicated IP (Standard)
plans.notes: Add-on: $24.95/month per standard dedicated IP. Managed dedicated IPs are $15/month per account plus tiered per-1,000 sending rates ($0.08/1K for 0-10M monthly, $0.04/1K for 10M-50M, $0.02/1K for 50M-100M).

limits: Pay-as-you-go: $0.10 per 1,000 emails, no monthly minimum
AWS free tier: 3,000 message charges/month for first 12 months only (not forever-free)
keyFeatures: HIPAA-eligible service — BAA available via AWS (execute before handling ePHI)

Shared, dedicated, or customer-owned IP address options
Lowest per-email cost among major providers at $0.10/1K
